digest.component_or_area: CLI confirmation output and verb mutation surface
propositions: Structural spy assertion on the shared confirmation reduce path (_confirm.emit/_confirm.emit_text) must ensure exactly one routed line per verb dispatch and no output outside the seam, catching regressions where confirmation bypasses the shared seam.

Verb inventory table (no-op-capable vs always-writes) must be curated and rendered in generated docs/cli-reference.md, with a CI drift gate that fails when a verb is added to rebar._cli._CONFIRM_SCOPE without classification.
Old-to-new confirmation-line mapping (pre-42cd70b889 to post-merge behavior) must be recorded as golden data in docs/cli-reference.md, derived from the same curated verb rows.
Confirmation formatters must produce output with no store I/O dependency, verified by formatting with empty tmp dir and REBAR_ROOT unset.
